modules.SelectionManager:
--[[
	SelectionManager
	Tipo:  ModuleScript
	Ruta:  ReplicatedStorage > StudioLite > Modules > SelectionManager
	Depende de: Signal

	Guarda el nodo seleccionado del proyecto (uno a la vez). Lo comparten el
	Explorer, el gizmo y las herramientas. Si el nodo seleccionado se elimina,
	la selección se limpia sola.

	  selection:Set(node)   -- nil limpia
	  selection:Get()       -- nodo o nil
	  selection:Clear()
	  selection.Changed:Connect(function(node) end)
]]

local Signal = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Signal"))

local SelectionManager = {}
SelectionManager.__index = SelectionManager

function SelectionManager.new(project)
	local self = setmetatable({}, SelectionManager)

	self.Project = project
	self._node = nil
	self.Changed = Signal.new()

	project.NodeRemoving:Connect(function(node)
		if self._node == node then
			self:Set(nil)
		end
	end)

	return self
end

function SelectionManager:Get()
	return self._node
end

function SelectionManager:Set(node)
	if node ~= nil and not self.Project:GetNode(node.Id) then
		return false
	end
	if self._node == node then
		return true
	end
	self._node = node
	self.Changed:Fire(node)
	return true
end

function SelectionManager:Clear()
	self:Set(nil)
end

return SelectionManager
modules.SceneSync:
--[[
	SceneSync
	Tipo:  ModuleScript
	Ruta:  ReplicatedStorage > StudioLite > Modules > SceneSync
	Depende de: Configuration

	Convierte el proyecto en objetos REALES del Workspace. El proyecto
	(ProjectManager) sigue siendo la fuente de verdad: SceneSync solo escucha
	NodeAdded / NodeRemoving / NodeChanged y crea, destruye o actualiza Instances.

	  - Solo se materializa el subárbol del servicio Workspace del proyecto, y solo
	    las clases de Configuration.Scene.MaterializedClasses (Part, Model, Folder).
	  - Viven dentro de Workspace.<Configuration.Scene.ContainerName>.
	  - Los scripts y el resto de servicios existen únicamente como datos.
	  - Todo se crea en el CLIENTE: solo lo ve este jugador y no se replica al servidor.

	Métodos:
	  GetInstance(node)                 -> Instance o nil
	  GetNodeFromInstance(instance)     -> nodo o nil (sube por los ancestros)
	  Raycast(origin, direction)        -> RaycastResult (solo contra la escena)
]]

local Configuration = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Configuration"))

local SceneSync = {}
SceneSync.__index = SceneSync

local ID_ATTRIBUTE = "StudioLiteId"

local function applyProperty(instance, name, value)
	if value == nil then
		return
	end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		if name == "CFrame" and instance:IsA("Model") then
			instance:PivotTo(value)
		else
			instance[name] = value
		end
	end)
	if not ok and Configuration.Debug then
		warn(string.format("[StudioLite] No se pudo aplicar '%s' a %s (%s)", name, instance.Name, instance.ClassName))
	end
end

function SceneSync.new(project)
	local self = setmetatable({}, SceneSync)

	self.Project = project
	self._instances = {} -- Id del nodo -> Instance
	self._connections = {}

	-- Si quedó una escena anterior (por ejemplo al reiniciar el editor), se descarta.
	local old = workspace:FindFirstChild(Configuration.Scene.ContainerName)
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end

	local container = Instance.new("Folder")
	container.Name = Configuration.Scene.ContainerName
	container.Parent = workspace
	self.Container = container

	local workspaceNode = project:GetService("Workspace")
	self._instances[workspaceNode.Id] = container
	container:SetAttribute(ID_ATTRIBUTE, workspaceNode.Id)

	for _, child in ipairs(workspaceNode.Children) do
		self:_create(child)
	end

	table.insert(self._connections, project.NodeAdded:Connect(function(node)
		self:_create(node)
	end))
	table.insert(self._connections, project.NodeRemoving:Connect(function(node)
		self:_remove(node)
	end))
	table.insert(self._connections, project.NodeChanged:Connect(function(node, field, propertyName)
		self:_onChanged(node, field, propertyName)
	end))

	return self
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Interno
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function SceneSync:_create(node)
	if self._instances[node.Id] then
		return
	end
	if not Configuration.Scene.MaterializedClasses[node.ClassName] then
		return
	end
	local parentInstance = node.Parent and self._instances[node.Parent.Id]
	if not parentInstance then
		return -- el padre no está en la escena (otro servicio, un script...)
	end

	local instance = Instance.new(node.ClassName)
	instance.Name = node.Name
	instance:SetAttribute(ID_ATTRIBUTE, node.Id)
	if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
		instance.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		instance.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	end
	for name, value in pairs(node.Properties) do
		applyProperty(instance, name, value)
	end
	instance.Parent = parentInstance
	self._instances[node.Id] = instance

	for _, child in ipairs(node.Children) do
		self:_create(child)
	end
end

function SceneSync:_remove(node)
	local instance = self._instances[node.Id]
	if not instance or instance == self.Container then
		return
	end

	local function unmap(current)
		self._instances[current.Id] = nil
		for _, child in ipairs(current.Children) do
			unmap(child)
		end
	end
	unmap(node)
	instance:Destroy()
end

function SceneSync:_onChanged(node, field, propertyName)
	local instance = self._instances[node.Id]
	if instance == self.Container then
		return
	end

	if field == "Name" then
		if instance then
			instance.Name = node.Name
		end
	elseif field == "Property" then
		if instance then
			applyProperty(instance, propertyName, node.Properties[propertyName])
		end
	elseif field == "Parent" then
		local newParent = node.Parent and self._instances[node.Parent.Id]
		if instance and newParent then
			instance.Parent = newParent
		elseif instance then
			self:_remove(node) -- salió de la escena
		elseif newParent then
			self:_create(node) -- entró en la escena
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Consulta
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function SceneSync:GetInstance(node)
	return node and self._instances[node.Id] or nil
end

function SceneSync:GetNodeFromInstance(instance)
	local current = instance
	while current and current ~= self.Container do
		local id = current:GetAttribute(ID_ATTRIBUTE)
		if id then
			return self.Project:GetNode(id)
		end
		current = current.Parent
	end
	return nil
end

function SceneSync:Raycast(origin, direction)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { self.Container }
	return workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
end

function SceneSync:Destroy()
	for _, connection in ipairs(self._connections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	self._connections = {}
	self._instances = {}
	self.Container:Destroy()
end

return SceneSync
modules.ProjectManager:
--[[
ProjectManager
Tipo:  ModuleScript
Ruta:  ReplicatedStorage > StudioLite > Modules > ProjectManager
Depende de: Configuration (hermano en la misma carpeta Modules)
 
Modelo de datos del proyecto. NO crea Instances: guarda el proyecto como
una jerarquía de nodos (tablas). Así el proyecto conserva clase, propiedades,
relaciones y código de scripts sin ejecutar nada, y se puede exportar
para guardar o para publicar más adelante.
 
Los métodos devuelven resultado, o nil/false + mensaje de error. No lanzan errores.
 
Nodo = {
Id, ClassName, Name, Parent, Children = {}, Properties = {},
IsService, Source (solo en scripts)
}
 
Eventos (Connect devuelve un objeto con :Disconnect()):
NodeAdded(node)
NodeRemoving(node)          -- se dispara para cada descendiente y luego para la raíz
NodeChanged(node, campo, nombrePropiedad?)   -- "Name", "Parent", "Property", "Source"
]]
 
local Configuration = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Configuration"))
 
local ProjectManager = {}
ProjectManager.__index = ProjectManager
 
---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Utilidades internas
---------------------------------------------------------------------
 
local function deepCopy(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then
        return value
    end
    local copy = {}
    for key, item in pairs(value) do
        copy[key] = deepCopy(item)
    end
    return copy
end
 
local function validName(name)
    return type(name) == "string" and #name > 0 and #name <= 100
end
 
local Signal = {}
Signal.__index = Signal
 
function Signal.new()
    return setmetatable({ _handlers = {} }, Signal)
end
 
function Signal:Connect(callback)
    local handler = { Callback = callback }
    table.insert(self._handlers, handler)
    return {
    Disconnect = function()
        local index = table.find(self._handlers, handler)
        if index then
            table.remove(self._handlers, index)
        end
    end,
    }
end
 
function Signal:Fire(...)
    for _, handler in ipairs(table.clone(self._handlers)) do
        task.spawn(handler.Callback, ...)
    end
end
 
---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Creación del proyecto
---------------------------------------------------------------------
 
function ProjectManager.new(name)
    local self = setmetatable({}, ProjectManager)
    
    self.Name = validName(name) and name or "Sin título"
    self.Nodes = {} -- Id -> nodo
    self.Roots = {} -- servicios sin padre (en orden)
    self.Services = {} -- nombre -> nodo de servicio
    self._nextId = 1
    
    self.NodeAdded = Signal.new()
    self.NodeRemoving = Signal.new()
    self.NodeChanged = Signal.new()
    
    for _, definition in ipairs(Configuration.Services) do
        local parent = definition.Parent and self.Services[definition.Parent] or nil
        local node = self:_register(definition.ClassName, definition.Name, parent, true, "Service:" .. definition.Name)
        self.Services[definition.Name] = node
    end
    
    return self
end
 
function ProjectManager:_register(className, name, parent, isService, id)
    if not id then
        id = "N" .. self._nextId
        self._nextId += 1
    end
    
    local node = {
    Id = id,
    ClassName = className,
    Name = name,
    Parent = parent,
    Children = {},
    Properties = {},
    IsService = isService or false,
    }
    
    local classInfo = Configuration.Classes[className]
    if classInfo and classInfo.IsScript then
        node.Source = ""
    end
    
    self.Nodes[id] = node
    table.insert(parent and parent.Children or self.Roots, node)
    return node
end
 
function ProjectManager:_ownsNode(node)
    return type(node) == "table" and node.Id ~= nil and self.Nodes[node.Id] == node
end
 
---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Consulta
---------------------------------------------------------------------
 
function ProjectManager:GetService(name)
    return self.Services[name]
end
 
function ProjectManager:GetNode(id)
    return self.Nodes[id]
end
 
function ProjectManager:GetChildren(node)
    if not self:_ownsNode(node) then
        return {}
    end
    return table.clone(node.Children)
end
 
function ProjectManager:GetDescendants(node)
    local result = {}
    if not self:_ownsNode(node) then
        return result
    end
    local function walk(current)
        for _, child in ipairs(current.Children) do
            table.insert(result, child)
            walk(child)
        end
    end
    walk(node)
    return result
end
 
function ProjectManager:GetPath(node)
    if not self:_ownsNode(node) then
        return ""
    end
    local names = {}
    local current = node
    while current do
        table.insert(names, 1, current.Name)
        current = current.Parent
    end
    return table.concat(names, ".")
end
 
---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Modificación
---------------------------------------------------------------------
 
function ProjectManager:CreateNode(className, parent, name, properties)
    if not Configuration.Classes[className] then
        return nil, "Clase no soportada: " .. tostring(className)
    end
    if not self:_ownsNode(parent) then
        return nil, "Padre inválido"
    end
    if name == nil then
        name = className
    end
    if not validName(name) then
        return nil, "Nombre inválido"
    end
    if properties ~= nil and type(properties) ~= "table" then
        return nil, "Propiedades inválidas"
    end
    
    local node = self:_register(className, name, parent, false)
    if properties then
        node.Properties = deepCopy(properties)
    end
    
    self.NodeAdded:Fire(node)
    return node
end
 
function ProjectManager:DestroyNode(node)
    if not self:_ownsNode(node) then
        return false, "Nodo inválido"
    end
    if node.IsService then
        return false, "Los servicios no se pueden eliminar"
    end
    
    -- Primero los descendientes (más profundos antes), luego el nodo.
    local removed = {}
    local function collect(current)
        for _, child in ipairs(current.Children) do
            collect(child)
        end
        table.insert(removed, current)
    end
    collect(node)
    
    for _, item in ipairs(removed) do
        self.NodeRemoving:Fire(item)
    end
    
    local siblings = node.Parent.Children
    local index = table.find(siblings, node)
    if index then
        table.remove(siblings, index)
    end
    for _, item in ipairs(removed) do
        self.Nodes[item.Id] = nil
    end
    node.Parent = nil
    
    return true
end
 
function ProjectManager:Rename(node, name)
    if not self:_ownsNode(node) then
        return false, "Nodo inválido"
    end
    if node.IsService then
        return false, "Los servicios no se pueden renombrar"
    end
    if not validName(name) then
        return false, "Nombre inválido"
    end
    
    node.Name = name
    self.NodeChanged:Fire(node, "Name")
    return true
end
 
function ProjectManager:Reparent(node, newParent, index)
    if not self:_ownsNode(node) then
        return false, "Nodo inválido"
    end
    if node.IsService then
        return false, "Los servicios no se pueden mover"
    end
    if not self:_ownsNode(newParent) then
        return false, "Destino inválido"
    end
    
    local ancestor = newParent
    while ancestor do
        if ancestor == node then
            return false, "No se puede mover un objeto dentro de sí mismo"
        end
        ancestor = ancestor.Parent
    end
    
    local oldSiblings = node.Parent.Children
    table.remove(oldSiblings, table.find(oldSiblings, node))
    
    node.Parent = newParent
    local siblings = newParent.Children
    if type(index) == "number" then
        index = math.clamp(math.floor(index), 1, #siblings + 1)
    else
        index = #siblings + 1
    end
    table.insert(siblings, index, node)
    
    self.NodeChanged:Fire(node, "Parent")
    return true
end
 
-- Las propiedades de los servicios sí se pueden editar (por ejemplo Lighting).
-- value = nil elimina la propiedad guardada.
function ProjectManager:SetProperty(node, propertyName, value)
    if not self:_ownsNode(node) then
        return false, "Nodo inválido"
    end
    if type(propertyName) ~= "string" or #propertyName == 0 then
        return false, "Nombre de propiedad inválido"
    end
    
    node.Properties[propertyName] = value
    self.NodeChanged:Fire(node, "Property", propertyName)
    return true
end
 
function ProjectManager:SetSource(node, source)
    if not self:_ownsNode(node) then
        return false, "Nodo inválido"
    end
    if node.Source == nil then
        return false, "El nodo no es un script"
    end
    if type(source) ~= "string" then
        return false, "El código debe ser texto"
    end
    
    node.Source = source
    self.NodeChanged:Fire(node, "Source")
    return true
end
 
---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Exportar / Importar (base del guardado y de la publicación futura)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
 
-- Devuelve una tabla simple. Los servicios no se exportan como nodos:
-- se recrean desde Configuration.Services. Los padres siempre aparecen antes que sus hijos.
-- Nota: los valores como Vector3 o Color3 se convertirán a un formato
-- guardable en la etapa 8; aquí Properties se copia tal cual.
function ProjectManager:Export()
    local nodes = {}
    local serviceProperties = {}
    
    local function walk(node)
        if node.IsService then
            if next(node.Properties) ~= nil then
                serviceProperties[node.Name] = deepCopy(node.Properties)
            end
        else
            table.insert(nodes, {
            Id = node.Id,
            ParentId = node.Parent.Id,
            Name = node.Name,
            ClassName = node.ClassName,
            Properties = deepCopy(node.Properties),
            Source = node.Source,
            })
        end
        for _, child in ipairs(node.Children) do
            walk(child)
        end
    end
    
    for _, root in ipairs(self.Roots) do
        walk(root)
    end
    
    return {
    Format = Configuration.ProjectFormatVersion,
    Name = self.Name,
    NextId = self._nextId,
    ServiceProperties = serviceProperties,
    Nodes = nodes,
    }
end
 
function ProjectManager.Import(data)
    if type(data) ~= "table" or data.Format ~= Configuration.ProjectFormatVersion then
        return nil, "Formato de proyecto no compatible"
    end
    if type(data.Nodes) ~= "table" then
        return nil, "Datos de proyecto inválidos"
    end
    
    local project = ProjectManager.new(data.Name)
    
    if type(data.ServiceProperties) == "table" then
        for serviceName, properties in pairs(data.ServiceProperties) do
            local service = project.Services[serviceName]
            if service and type(properties) == "table" then
                service.Properties = deepCopy(properties)
            end
        end
    end
    
    local maxId = 0
    for position, entry in ipairs(data.Nodes) do
        if type(entry) ~= "table" or type(entry.Id) ~= "string" then
            return nil, "Nodo inválido en la posición " .. position
        end
        
        local number = tonumber(string.match(entry.Id, "^N(%d+)$"))
        if not number then
            return nil, "Id inválido: " .. entry.Id
        end
        if project.Nodes[entry.Id] then
            return nil, "Id duplicado: " .. entry.Id
        end
        
        local parent = project.Nodes[entry.ParentId]
        if not parent then
            return nil, "Padre inexistente para " .. entry.Id
        end
        if not Configuration.Classes[entry.ClassName] then
            return nil, "Clase no soportada: " .. tostring(entry.ClassName)
        end
        if not validName(entry.Name) then
            return nil, "Nombre inválido en " .. entry.Id
        end
        
        local node = project:_register(entry.ClassName, entry.Name, parent, false, entry.Id)
        if type(entry.Properties) == "table" then
            node.Properties = deepCopy(entry.Properties)
        end
        if node.Source ~= nil and type(entry.Source) == "string" then
            node.Source = entry.Source
        end
        
        maxId = math.max(maxId, number)
    end
    
    project._nextId = math.max(maxId + 1, tonumber(data.NextId) or 1)
    return project
end
 
return ProjectManager
modules.UIReferences:
--[[
	UIReferences
	Tipo:  ModuleScript
	Ruta:  ReplicatedStorage > StudioLite > Modules > UIReferences
	Depende de: Configuration (hermano en la misma carpeta Modules)

	(REEMPLAZA el de la etapa 2: Viewport ahora acepta cualquier GuiObject y se
	añaden los elementos opcionales del HUD de la etapa 3.)

	Encuentra los elementos de la interfaz POR NOMBRE (búsqueda recursiva dentro
	del ScreenGui) y los devuelve en una tabla organizada. Así puedes mover,
	reagrupar o restilizar elementos a mano sin romper la lógica: solo importa
	que cada nombre exista una vez y sea del tipo correcto.

	Resolve(gui) devuelve (refs, missing):
	  refs.Gui, refs.Window, refs.MenuBar, refs.Toolbar, refs.Viewport
	  refs.MenuLayer, refs.MenuBlocker
	  refs.Menus[menú]  = { Button, Dropdown, Items = { [idOpción] = botón } }
	  refs.Tools[id]    = { Button, Indicator }   (Indicator puede ser nil)
	  refs.Actions[id]  = botón
	  refs.Explorer     = { Panel, List, ItemTemplate }
	  refs.Properties   = { Panel, List, RowTemplate }
	  refs.Hud          = { Panel, FlyButton, UpButton, DownButton, StatusLabel }  (todos opcionales)
	  missing = lista de textos con lo que falta o tiene el tipo incorrecto
	  optionalMissing = elementos opcionales que no existen (la interfaz de la etapa 2
	                    no los tiene: el editor funciona con teclado/ratón, pero en
	                    móvil necesitas regenerar la interfaz para tener los botones)
]]

local Configuration = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Configuration"))

local UIReferences = {}

function UIReferences.Resolve(gui)
	local missing = {}
	local optionalMissing = {}

	-- Igual que find, pero si falta no se considera un error.
	local function findOptional(name, className)
		local instance = gui:FindFirstChild(name, true)
		if not instance or not instance:IsA(className) then
			table.insert(optionalMissing, name)
			return nil
		end
		return instance
	end

	local function find(name, className)
		local instance = gui:FindFirstChild(name, true)
		if not instance then
			table.insert(missing, name)
			return nil
		end
		if not instance:IsA(className) then
			table.insert(missing, name .. " (debe ser " .. className .. ")")
			return nil
		end
		return instance
	end

	local refs = {
		Gui = gui,
		Window = find("Window", "GuiObject"),
		MenuBar = find("MenuBar", "GuiObject"),
		Toolbar = find("Toolbar", "GuiObject"),
		Viewport = find("Viewport", "GuiObject"),
		MenuLayer = find("MenuLayer", "GuiObject"),
		MenuBlocker = find("MenuBlocker", "GuiButton"),
		Explorer = {
			Panel = find("ExplorerPanel", "GuiObject"),
			List = find("ExplorerList", "ScrollingFrame"),
			ItemTemplate = find("ExplorerItemTemplate", "GuiButton"),
		},
		Properties = {
			Panel = find("PropertiesPanel", "GuiObject"),
			List = find("PropertiesList", "ScrollingFrame"),
			RowTemplate = find("PropertiesRowTemplate", "GuiObject"),
		},
		Hud = {
			Panel = findOptional("ViewportHud", "GuiObject"),
			FlyButton = findOptional("FlyButton", "GuiButton"),
			UpButton = findOptional("UpButton", "GuiButton"),
			DownButton = findOptional("DownButton", "GuiButton"),
			StatusLabel = findOptional("StatusLabel", "TextLabel"),
		},
		Menus = {},
		Tools = {},
		Actions = {},
	}

	for _, menu in ipairs(Configuration.Interface.Menus) do
		local entry = {
			Button = find("MenuButton_" .. menu.Name, "GuiButton"),
			Dropdown = find("Menu_" .. menu.Name, "GuiObject"),
			Items = {},
		}
		for _, item in ipairs(menu.Items) do
			entry.Items[item.Id] = find("MenuItem_" .. menu.Name .. "_" .. item.Id, "GuiButton")
		end
		refs.Menus[menu.Name] = entry
	end

	for _, tool in ipairs(Configuration.Interface.Tools) do
		local button = find("Tool_" .. tool.Id, "GuiButton")
		refs.Tools[tool.Id] = {
			Button = button,
			Indicator = button and button:FindFirstChild("ActiveIndicator") or nil,
		}
	end

	for _, action in ipairs(Configuration.Interface.Actions) do
		refs.Actions[action.Id] = find("Action_" .. action.Id, "GuiButton")
	end

	return refs, missing, optionalMissing
end

return UIReferences
modules.InterfaceController:
--[[
InterfaceController
Tipo:  ModuleScript
Ruta:  ReplicatedStorage > StudioLite > Modules > InterfaceController
Depende de: Configuration (hermano en la misma carpeta Modules)
Recibe: la tabla de referencias que devuelve UIReferences.Resolve(gui)

Comportamiento de la interfaz: abrir y cerrar menús, resaltar la herramienta
activa y avisar de lo que pulsa el usuario. NO modifica colores ni estilos:
solo cambia Visible, así el aspecto lo controlas tú en los elementos.

controller = InterfaceController.new(refs)
controller:Start()

Eventos:
ToolRequested(toolId)       -- "Select", "Move", "Rotate", "Scale", "Insert"
CommandRequested(commandId) -- "File.New", "Edit.Undo", "Insert.Part", ...

Métodos: SetActiveTool(id), GetActiveTool(), OpenMenu(name), CloseMenus(), Destroy()
]]

local Configuration = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Configuration"))

local InterfaceController = {}
InterfaceController.__index = InterfaceController

function InterfaceController.new(refs)
    local self = setmetatable({}, InterfaceController)
    
    self._refs = refs
    self._openMenu = nil
    self._activeTool = nil
    self._connections = {}
    
    self._toolEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
    self._commandEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
    self.ToolRequested = self._toolEvent.Event
    self.CommandRequested = self._commandEvent.Event
    
    return self
end

function InterfaceController:_connect(signal, callback)
    table.insert(self._connections, signal:Connect(callback))
end

function InterfaceController:Start()
    local refs = self._refs
    local interface = Configuration.Interface
    
    refs.MenuLayer.Visible = false
    
    for _, menu in ipairs(interface.Menus) do
        local entry = refs.Menus[menu.Name]
        entry.Dropdown.Visible = false
        
        self:_connect(entry.Button.Activated, function()
            if self._openMenu == menu.Name then
                self:CloseMenus()
            else
                self:OpenMenu(menu.Name)
            end
        end)
        
        for _, item in ipairs(menu.Items) do
            local commandId = menu.Name .. "." .. item.Id
            self:_connect(entry.Items[item.Id].Activated, function()
                self:CloseMenus()
                self._commandEvent:Fire(commandId)
            end)
        end
    end
    
    self:_connect(refs.MenuBlocker.Activated, function()
        self:CloseMenus()
    end)
    
    for _, tool in ipairs(interface.Tools) do
        self:_connect(refs.Tools[tool.Id].Button.Activated, function()
            self:SetActiveTool(tool.Id)
            self._toolEvent:Fire(tool.Id)
        end)
    end
    
    for _, action in ipairs(interface.Actions) do
        self:_connect(refs.Actions[action.Id].Activated, function()
            self._commandEvent:Fire(action.Command)
        end)
    end
    
    self:SetActiveTool(interface.DefaultTool)
end

function InterfaceController:OpenMenu(name)
    local entry = self._refs.Menus[name]
    if not entry then
        return
    end
    
    self:CloseMenus()
    
    -- El desplegable se coloca bajo su botón en el momento de abrirlo, así sigue
    -- funcionando aunque muevas los botones de menú a mano.
    local layer = self._refs.MenuLayer
    local button = entry.Button
    entry.Dropdown.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
    button.AbsolutePosition.X - layer.AbsolutePosition.X,
    button.AbsolutePosition.Y + button.AbsoluteSize.Y - layer.AbsolutePosition.Y
    )
    entry.Dropdown.Visible = true
    layer.Visible = true
    self._openMenu = name
end

function InterfaceController:CloseMenus()
    if self._openMenu then
        self._refs.Menus[self._openMenu].Dropdown.Visible = false
    end
    self._refs.MenuLayer.Visible = false
    self._openMenu = nil
end

function InterfaceController:SetActiveTool(toolId)
    if not self._refs.Tools[toolId] then
        return false
    end
    
    for id, entry in pairs(self._refs.Tools) do
        if entry.Indicator then
            entry.Indicator.Visible = (id == toolId)
        end
    end
    self._activeTool = toolId
    return true
end

function InterfaceController:GetActiveTool()
    return self._activeTool
end

function InterfaceController:Destroy()
    for _, connection in ipairs(self._connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    self._connections = {}
    self._toolEvent:Destroy()
    self._commandEvent:Destroy()
end

return InterfaceController
modules.EditorController:
--[[
	EditorController
	Tipo:  ModuleScript
	Ruta:  ReplicatedStorage > StudioLite > Modules > EditorController
	Depende de: Configuration, SceneSync, SelectionManager, EditorActions, EditorCamera,
	            ViewportInput, TransformGizmo, ExplorerController

	Une todas las piezas del editor 3D. No contiene lógica de bajo nivel: solo
	conecta eventos entre módulos.

	  Interfaz (InterfaceController) --> herramienta activa / comandos
	  ViewportInput  --> giro de cámara, tap (seleccionar o insertar), teclas
	  TransformGizmo --> mover objetos (se escribe en el proyecto)
	  Proyecto       --> SceneSync (Workspace real) y ExplorerController

	Herramientas: Select y Move seleccionan; Move añade flechas de movimiento;
	Insert coloca una Part donde toques. Rotate y Scale quedan para otra etapa.
	Teclas: F = vuelo/caminar, Supr o Retroceso = eliminar.
Comandos: Insert.<Clase>, Edit.Delete y Edit.Duplicate están implementados; el resto
(Undo, Redo, Copy, Paste, Group, Ungroup, File.*) se avisa en Output como pendiente.

	controller = EditorController.new(refs, interfaceController, project)
	controller:Start()
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Configuration = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Configuration"))
local SceneSync = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("SceneSync"))
local SelectionManager = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("SelectionManager"))
local EditorActions = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("EditorActions"))
local EditorCamera = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("EditorCamera"))
local ViewportInput = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("ViewportInput"))
local TransformGizmo = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("TransformGizmo"))
local ExplorerController = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("ExplorerController"))

local EditorController = {}
EditorController.__index = EditorController

-- La interfaz de la etapa 2 tenía Window y Viewport opacos. Para ver el mundo 3D
-- real a través de la zona del Viewport deben ser transparentes. Con la interfaz
-- nueva ya lo son y esto no cambia nada.
local function prepareViewport(refs)
	refs.Window.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	refs.Viewport.BackgroundTransparency = 1
end

local function outermostModel(node)
	while node.Parent and node.Parent.ClassName == "Model" do
		node = node.Parent
	end
	return node
end

function EditorController.new(refs, interfaceController, project)
	local self = setmetatable({}, EditorController)

	self.Refs = refs
	self.Interface = interfaceController
	self.Project = project
	self._tool = interfaceController:GetActiveTool() or Configuration.Interface.DefaultTool
	self._dragStart = nil
	self._notified = {}

	return self
end

function EditorController:Start()
	local refs = self.Refs
	local project = self.Project

	prepareViewport(refs)

	local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	-- Núcleo: escena real, selección, acciones.
	self.Scene = SceneSync.new(project)
	self.Selection = SelectionManager.new(project)
	self.Actions = EditorActions.new(project, self.Selection)

	-- Presentación: explorador, gizmo, cámara y entrada.
	self.Explorer = ExplorerController.new(refs.Explorer, project, self.Selection)
	self.Gizmo = TransformGizmo.new(project, self.Scene, self.Selection, playerGui)
	self.Camera = EditorCamera.new(refs.Hud)
	self.Input = ViewportInput.new(refs.Viewport)

	self.Explorer:Start()
	self:_createDefaultScene()

	-- Interfaz.
	self.Interface.ToolRequested:Connect(function(toolId)
		self:_setTool(toolId)
	end)
	self.Interface.CommandRequested:Connect(function(commandId)
		self:_onCommand(commandId)
	end)

	-- Entrada.
	self.Input.Tapped:Connect(function(position)
		self:_onTap(position)
	end)
	self.Input.LookDelta:Connect(function(dx, dy, source)
		self.Camera:Look(dx, dy, source)
	end)
	self.Input.KeyPressed:Connect(function(keyCode)
		self:_onKey(keyCode)
	end)

	-- Gizmo de movimiento.
	self.Gizmo.Pressed:Connect(function(down)
		self.Input:SetGizmoPressed(down)
	end)
	self.Gizmo.DragStarted:Connect(function()
		self:_onDragStarted()
	end)
	self.Gizmo.Dragged:Connect(function(offset)
		self:_onDragged(offset)
	end)
	self.Gizmo.DragEnded:Connect(function()
		self._dragStart = nil
	end)

	-- Estado en pantalla.
	self.Selection.Changed:Connect(function()
		self:_updateStatus()
	end)
	self.Camera.FlyingChanged:Connect(function()
		self:_updateStatus()
	end)

	self.Input:Start()
	self.Camera:Start()
	self:_setTool(self._tool)

	print("[StudioLite] Editor 3D listo. Clic derecho o arrastrar para girar, F = vuelo, Supr = eliminar")
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Escena inicial
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function EditorController:_createDefaultScene()
	local scene = Configuration.Scene
	if not scene.CreateBaseplate then
		return
	end
	if workspace:FindFirstChild("Baseplate") then
		print("[StudioLite] El lugar ya tiene una Baseplate; no se crea otra")
		return
	end

	local node = self.Project:CreateNode("Part", self.Project:GetService("Workspace"), "Baseplate", table.clone(scene.Baseplate))
	if not node then
		warn("[StudioLite] No se pudo crear la Baseplate inicial")
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Herramientas y comandos
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function EditorController:_setTool(toolId)
	self._tool = toolId
	self.Gizmo:SetMode(toolId == "Move" and "Move" or "None")

	if (toolId == "Rotate" or toolId == "Scale") and not self._notified[toolId] then
		self._notified[toolId] = true
		print("[StudioLite] '" .. toolId .. "' se implementará en una etapa posterior (por ahora solo selecciona)")
	end

	self:_updateStatus()
end

function EditorController:_onCommand(commandId)
	local menu, id = string.match(commandId, "^(%w+)%.(%w+)$")

	if menu == "Insert" then
		self.Actions:InsertClass(id)
	elseif commandId == "Edit.Delete" then
		self.Actions:DeleteSelected()
	elseif commandId == "Edit.Duplicate" then
		self.Actions:DuplicateSelected()
	elseif not self._notified[commandId] then
		self._notified[commandId] = true
		print("[StudioLite] '" .. commandId .. "' todavía no está implementado")
	end
end

function EditorController:_onKey(keyCode)
	if keyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then
		self.Camera:ToggleFlying()
	elseif keyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Delete or keyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace then
		self.Actions:DeleteSelected()
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Mundo 3D
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function EditorController:_onTap(guiPosition)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then
		return
	end

	local ray = camera:ScreenPointToRay(guiPosition.X, guiPosition.Y)
	local result = self.Scene:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * Configuration.Editor.RaycastDistance)

	if self._tool == "Insert" then
		if result then
			self.Actions:InsertPartOnSurface(result.Position, result.Normal)
		else
			self.Actions:InsertPartAt(ray.Origin + ray.Direction * Configuration.Editor.InsertDistance)
		end
		return
	end

	if result then
		local node = self.Scene:GetNodeFromInstance(result.Instance)
		if node then
			self.Selection:Set(outermostModel(node))
			return
		end
	end
	self.Selection:Clear()
end

-- Movimiento: se guarda la posición inicial de cada Part dentro de lo seleccionado
-- y, al arrastrar, se escribe en el proyecto (SceneSync mueve los objetos reales).
function EditorController:_onDragStarted()
	local selected = self.Selection:Get()
	if not selected then
		return
	end

	local start = {}
	local function collect(node)
		if node.ClassName == "Part" then
			start[node] = node.Properties.CFrame or CFrame.new()
		end
		for _, child in ipairs(node.Children) do
			collect(child)
		end
	end
	collect(selected)
	self._dragStart = start
end

function EditorController:_onDragged(offset)
	if not self._dragStart then
		return
	end
	for node, cframe in pairs(self._dragStart) do
		self.Project:SetProperty(node, "CFrame", cframe + offset)
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Estado en pantalla
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function EditorController:_updateStatus()
	local label = self.Refs.Hud.StatusLabel
	if not label then
		return
	end

	local selected = self.Selection:Get()
	local text = string.format("%s | %s", self.Camera:IsFlying() and "Fly" or "Walk", self._tool)
	if selected then
		text ..= " | " .. selected.Name
	end
	label.Text = text
end

return EditorController
modules.EditorActions:
--[[
	EditorActions
	Tipo:  ModuleScript
	Ruta:  ReplicatedStorage > StudioLite > Modules > EditorActions
	Depende de: Configuration

	Operaciones de edición sobre el proyecto: insertar y eliminar. Siempre modifican
	el PROYECTO (ProjectManager); SceneSync se encarga de reflejarlo en el Workspace.
	Después de crear un objeto, queda seleccionado.

	Dónde se inserta: si hay algo seleccionado, dentro de él cuando es un servicio,
	Model o Folder; si es otra cosa (una Part, un script), junto a ella en su mismo
	padre. Sin selección, en el servicio de Configuration.Editor.DefaultParents.

	Métodos:
	  InsertClass(className)              -- comando del menú Insert
	  InsertPartInFront()                 -- delante de la cámara
	  InsertPartAt(position)              -- en una posición del mundo
	  InsertPartOnSurface(position, normal) -- apoyada sobre una superficie
	  DuplicateSelected()                 -- copia el seleccionado (y sus hijos) junto al original
	  DeleteSelected()
]]

local Configuration = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Configuration"))

local EditorActions = {}
EditorActions.__index = EditorActions

local CONTAINER_CLASSES = { Model = true, Folder = true }

local function snapVector(vector, increment)
	if increment <= 0 then
		return vector
	end
	return Vector3.new(
		math.round(vector.X / increment) * increment,
		math.round(vector.Y / increment) * increment,
		math.round(vector.Z / increment) * increment
	)
end

function EditorActions.new(project, selection)
	local self = setmetatable({}, EditorActions)
	self.Project = project
	self.Selection = selection
	return self
end

function EditorActions:_resolveParent(className)
	local selected = self.Selection:Get()
	if selected then
		if selected.IsService or CONTAINER_CLASSES[selected.ClassName] then
			return selected
		end
		if selected.Parent then
			return selected.Parent
		end
	end
	local serviceName = Configuration.Editor.DefaultParents[className] or "Workspace"
	return self.Project:GetService(serviceName)
end

function EditorActions:_createPart(position)
	local properties = table.clone(Configuration.Scene.PartDefaults)
	properties.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)

	local parent = self:_resolveParent("Part")
	local node, err = self.Project:CreateNode("Part", parent, nil, properties)
	if not node then
		warn("[StudioLite] No se pudo insertar la Part: " .. tostring(err))
		return nil
	end
	self.Selection:Set(node)
	return node
end

function EditorActions:InsertPartAt(position)
	return self:_createPart(snapVector(position, Configuration.Editor.InsertGrid))
end

function EditorActions:InsertPartInFront()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local position = camera.CFrame.Position + camera.CFrame.LookVector * Configuration.Editor.InsertDistance
	return self:InsertPartAt(position)
end

-- Apoya la Part sobre la superficie: se ajusta a la cuadrícula en los ejes de la
-- superficie y se deja exacta en el eje de la normal para que no quede hundida.
function EditorActions:InsertPartOnSurface(hitPosition, normal)
	local size = Configuration.Scene.PartDefaults.Size
	local half = (math.abs(normal.X) * size.X + math.abs(normal.Y) * size.Y + math.abs(normal.Z) * size.Z) / 2
	local position = hitPosition + normal * half

	local increment = Configuration.Editor.InsertGrid
	local function snap(value, normalComponent)
		if increment <= 0 or math.abs(normalComponent) > 0.5 then
			return value
		end
		return math.round(value / increment) * increment
	end

	return self:_createPart(Vector3.new(snap(position.X, normal.X), snap(position.Y, normal.Y), snap(position.Z, normal.Z)))
end

function EditorActions:InsertClass(className)
	if not Configuration.Classes[className] then
		warn("[StudioLite] Clase no soportada: " .. tostring(className))
		return nil
	end
	if className == "Part" then
		return self:InsertPartInFront()
	end

	local node, err = self.Project:CreateNode(className, self:_resolveParent(className))
	if not node then
		warn("[StudioLite] No se pudo insertar " .. className .. ": " .. tostring(err))
		return nil
	end
	self.Selection:Set(node)
	return node
end

-- Duplica el nodo seleccionado con todos sus descendientes (propiedades y código),
-- junto al original (mismo padre), y selecciona la copia. Los servicios no se
-- duplican. Si algo falla a mitad, la copia parcial se elimina.
function EditorActions:DuplicateSelected()
	local source = self.Selection:Get()
	if not source then
		return nil
	end
	if source.IsService or not source.Parent then
		warn("[StudioLite] Los servicios no se pueden duplicar")
		return nil
	end

	local project = self.Project
	local rootClone = nil

	local function copy(original, parent)
		local clone, err = project:CreateNode(original.ClassName, parent, original.Name, table.clone(original.Properties or {}))
		if not clone then
			return nil, err
		end
		rootClone = rootClone or clone

		local classInfo = Configuration.Classes[original.ClassName]
		if classInfo and classInfo.IsScript and original.Source ~= nil then
			project:SetSource(clone, original.Source)
		end

		for _, child in ipairs(table.clone(original.Children)) do
			local childClone, childErr = copy(child, clone)
			if not childClone then
				return nil, childErr
			end
		end
		return clone
	end

	local root, err = copy(source, source.Parent)
	if not root then
		if rootClone then
			project:DestroyNode(rootClone) -- no dejar una copia a medias
		end
		warn("[StudioLite] No se pudo duplicar: " .. tostring(err))
		return nil
	end

	self.Selection:Set(root)
	return root
end

function EditorActions:DeleteSelected()
	local node = self.Selection:Get()
	if not node then
		return false
	end
	local ok, err = self.Project:DestroyNode(node)
	if not ok then
		warn("[StudioLite] No se pudo eliminar: " .. tostring(err))
	end
	return ok
end

return EditorActions
modules.EditorCamera:
--[[
	EditorCamera
	Tipo:  ModuleScript
	Ruta:  ReplicatedStorage > StudioLite > Modules > EditorCamera
	Depende de: Configuration, Signal

	Cámara en primera persona del editor, con dos modos:
	  - Fly (vuelo):   cámara libre que atraviesa todo. El personaje se ancla (solo
	                   en este cliente) para que no caiga ni estorbe.
	  - Walk (caminar): la cámara sigue la cabeza del personaje real, que camina por
	                   el mapa con colisiones y gravedad.

	La cámara es Scriptable en ambos modos (en primera persona "bloqueada" de Roblox
	el ratón queda fijo en el centro y no podrías usar los paneles).

	Movimiento: se lee del ControlModule de Roblox (PlayerModule:GetControls()), así
	funcionan WASD, el joystick móvil y el mando sin código extra.
	  Fly:  joystick/WASD mueven, E o Espacio suben, Q baja, Shift acelera.
	  Walk: joystick/WASD mueven, Espacio salta.
	Giro: botón derecho + ratón, o arrastrar con un dedo (ver ViewportInput).

	Botones opcionales de la interfaz (refs.Hud): FlyButton, UpButton, DownButton.

	Métodos: Start(), Stop(), SetFlying(bool), ToggleFlying(), IsFlying(),
	         Look(dx, dy, source), LookAt(position, target)
	Evento:  FlyingChanged(isFlying)
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Configuration = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Configuration"))
local Signal = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Signal"))

local BIND_NAME = "StudioLiteEditorCamera"

local EditorCamera = {}
EditorCamera.__index = EditorCamera

local function isPointerInput(input)
	return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end

function EditorCamera.new(hud)
	local self = setmetatable({}, EditorCamera)

	self._hud = hud or {}
	self._flying = false
	self._yaw = 0
	self._pitch = 0
	self._position = Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
	self._upHeld = false
	self._downHeld = false
	self._upInput = nil
	self._downInput = nil
	self._started = false
	self._controls = nil
	self._character = nil
	self._humanoid = nil
	self._root = nil
	self._head = nil
	self._connections = {}
	self._characterConnections = {}

	self.FlyingChanged = Signal.new()

	return self
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Ciclo de vida
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function EditorCamera:Start()
	if self._started then
		return
	end
	self._started = true

	local settings = Configuration.Camera
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer

	self:_loadControls()
	self:LookAt(settings.StartPosition, settings.StartLookAt)
	self._flying = settings.StartFlying
	self:_bindHud()
	self:_refreshHud()

	table.insert(self._connections, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		self:_setupCharacter(character)
	end))
	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(self._setupCharacter, self, player.Character)
	end

	RunService:BindToRenderStep(BIND_NAME, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(dt)
		self:_step(dt)
	end)
end

function EditorCamera:Stop()
	if not self._started then
		return
	end
	self._started = false

	RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(BIND_NAME)
	for _, connection in ipairs(self._connections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	self._connections = {}
	self:_clearCharacterConnections()

	if self._root then
		self._root.Anchored = false
	end
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera then
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
	end
end

function EditorCamera:_loadControls()
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local ok, controls = pcall(function()
		local playerScripts = player:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts", 10)
		local module = playerScripts:WaitForChild("PlayerModule", 10)
		return require(module):GetControls()
	end)
	if ok and controls then
		self._controls = controls
	else
		warn("[StudioLite] No se pudo acceder a PlayerModule; la cámara usará solo el teclado (sin joystick móvil)")
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Interfaz (botones opcionales)
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function EditorCamera:_bindHud()
	local hud = self._hud

	if hud.FlyButton then
		table.insert(self._connections, hud.FlyButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			self:ToggleFlying()
		end))
	end

	if hud.UpButton then
		table.insert(self._connections, hud.UpButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if isPointerInput(input) then
				self._upInput = input
				self._upHeld = true
			end
		end))
	end
	if hud.DownButton then
		table.insert(self._connections, hud.DownButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if isPointerInput(input) then
				self._downInput = input
				self._downHeld = true
			end
		end))
	end

	-- Se suelta el botón cuando termina EL MISMO toque que lo pulsó, aunque el dedo
	-- se haya salido del botón. Así soltar el joystick no corta la subida.
	table.insert(self._connections, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input == self._upInput then
			self._upInput = nil
			self._upHeld = false
		end
		if input == self._downInput then
			self._downInput = nil
			self._downHeld = false
		end
	end))
end

function EditorCamera:_refreshHud()
	local hud = self._hud
	if hud.FlyButton then
		hud.FlyButton.Text = self._flying and "Fly: ON" or "Fly: OFF"
	end
	if hud.UpButton then
		hud.UpButton.Text = self._flying and "Up" or "Jump"
	end
	if hud.DownButton then
		hud.DownButton.Visible = self._flying
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Personaje
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function EditorCamera:_clearCharacterConnections()
	for _, connection in ipairs(self._characterConnections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	self._characterConnections = {}
end

function EditorCamera:_setupCharacter(character)
	self:_clearCharacterConnections()
	self._character = character
	self._humanoid, self._root, self._head = nil, nil, nil

	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
	local head = character:WaitForChild("Head", 10)
	if self._character ~= character then
		return -- reapareció otro personaje mientras esperábamos
	end

	self._humanoid, self._root, self._head = humanoid, root, head

	if humanoid then
		humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
	end

	-- En primera persona el personaje no debe verse (solo en este cliente).
	local function hide(instance)
		if instance:IsA("BasePart") or instance:IsA("Decal") then
			instance.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
		end
	end
	for _, descendant in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		hide(descendant)
	end
	table.insert(self._characterConnections, character.DescendantAdded:Connect(hide))

	self:_applyAnchor()
end

-- En vuelo el personaje queda anclado; al caminar, libre.
function EditorCamera:_applyAnchor()
	if self._root then
		self._root.Anchored = self._flying
	end
end

-- Al pasar de vuelo a caminar, el personaje aparece donde está la cámara.
function EditorCamera:_placeCharacterAtCamera()
	local character, root, head = self._character, self._root, self._head
	if not (character and root) then
		return
	end

	local offset = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
	if head then
		offset = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, Configuration.Camera.EyeOffset, 0) - root.Position
	end
	character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(self._position - offset) * CFrame.Angles(0, self._yaw, 0))
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Control
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function EditorCamera:LookAt(position, target)
	local direction = (target - position).Unit
	self._position = position
	self._yaw = math.atan2(-direction.X, -direction.Z)
	self._pitch = math.asin(direction.Y)
end

function EditorCamera:Look(dx, dy, source)
	local settings = Configuration.Camera
	local sensitivity = source == "Touch" and settings.TouchSensitivity or settings.MouseSensitivity
	local maxPitch = math.rad(settings.MaxPitch)
	self._yaw -= dx * sensitivity
	self._pitch = math.clamp(self._pitch - dy * sensitivity, -maxPitch, maxPitch)
end

function EditorCamera:SetFlying(flying)
	flying = flying and true or false
	if flying == self._flying then
		return
	end

	if not flying then
		self:_placeCharacterAtCamera()
	end
	self._flying = flying
	self._upHeld, self._downHeld = false, false
	self._upInput, self._downInput = nil, nil

	self:_applyAnchor()
	self:_refreshHud()
	self.FlyingChanged:Fire(flying)
end

function EditorCamera:ToggleFlying()
	self:SetFlying(not self._flying)
end

function EditorCamera:IsFlying()
	return self._flying
end

function EditorCamera:_getMoveVector()
	if self._controls then
		local ok, vector = pcall(self._controls.GetMoveVector, self._controls)
		if ok and typeof(vector) == "Vector3" then
			return vector
		end
	end

	-- Sin PlayerModule: solo teclado.
	local function down(key)
		return UserInputService:IsKeyDown(key) and 1 or 0
	end
	return Vector3.new(
		down(Enum.KeyCode.D) - down(Enum.KeyCode.A),
		0,
		down(Enum.KeyCode.S) - down(Enum.KeyCode.W)
	)
end

function EditorCamera:_step(dt)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then
		return
	end
	if camera.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	end

	local settings = Configuration.Camera
	local rotation = CFrame.fromOrientation(self._pitch, self._yaw, 0)
	local typing = UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() ~= nil

	local function key(code)
		return not typing and UserInputService:IsKeyDown(code)
	end

	if self._flying then
		local move = self:_getMoveVector()
		local vertical = 0
		if self._upHeld or key(Enum.KeyCode.E) or key(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
			vertical += 1
		end
		if self._downHeld or key(Enum.KeyCode.Q) then
			vertical -= 1
		end

		local direction = rotation.RightVector * move.X + rotation.LookVector * -move.Z + Vector3.new(0, vertical, 0)
		if direction.Magnitude > 1 then
			direction = direction.Unit
		end

		local speed = settings.FlySpeed
		if key(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
			speed *= settings.FastMultiplier
		end
		self._position += direction * speed * dt
	else
		local head = self._head
		if head and head.Parent then
			self._position = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, settings.EyeOffset, 0)
		end
		if self._upHeld and self._humanoid then
			self._humanoid.Jump = true
		end
	end

	camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(self._position) * rotation
	camera.Focus = camera.CFrame
end

return EditorCamera
modules.ViewportInput:
--[[
	ViewportInput
	Tipo:  ModuleScript
	Ruta:  ReplicatedStorage > StudioLite > Modules > ViewportInput
	Depende de: Configuration, Signal

	Traduce la entrada (ratón, táctil, teclado) en eventos del editor 3D. Solo
	atiende lo que empieza dentro del elemento "Viewport" y que ningún botón o
	panel de la interfaz ha consumido (gameProcessed).

	Eventos:
	  Tapped(guiPosition)          clic izquierdo o toque corto (posición en espacio GUI)
	  LookDelta(dx, dy, source)    giro de cámara: botón derecho (ratón) o arrastre (táctil)
	  KeyPressed(keyCode)          teclas pulsadas fuera de cajas de texto

	Móvil: un toque corto selecciona/inserta; un arrastre gira la cámara. Los
	arrastres que empiezan en la zona del joystick (Configuration.Camera.JoystickZone)
	se ignoran para no girar la cámara mientras te mueves.

	Coordenadas: todo se expresa en espacio GUI (el mismo que AbsolutePosition y
	Camera:ScreenPointToRay). Si en móvil el objeto elegido queda desplazado
	verticalmente respecto al dedo, el ajuste está SOLO en getGuiPosition.
]]

local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Configuration = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Configuration"))
local Signal = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Signal"))

local ViewportInput = {}
ViewportInput.__index = ViewportInput

local function getGuiPosition(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		return Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
	end
	return UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() - GuiService:GetGuiInset()
end

function ViewportInput.new(viewport)
	local self = setmetatable({}, ViewportInput)

	self.Viewport = viewport
	self.Tapped = Signal.new()
	self.LookDelta = Signal.new()
	self.KeyPressed = Signal.new()

	self._touches = {} -- InputObject -> estado
	self._press = nil -- estado del clic izquierdo
	self._looking = false -- botón derecho pulsado
	self._gizmoDown = false
	self._gizmoUpTime = 0
	self._connections = {}

	return self
end

function ViewportInput:Start()
	local function connect(signal, callback)
		table.insert(self._connections, signal:Connect(callback))
	end

	connect(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
		self:_onBegan(input, processed)
	end)
	connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
		self:_onChanged(input)
	end)
	connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
		self:_onEnded(input)
	end)
	connect(UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased, function()
		self:_cancelAll()
	end)
end

-- El gizmo avisa cuando el usuario pulsa/suelta una flecha, para que ese toque
-- no gire la cámara ni cuente como un tap en el mundo.
function ViewportInput:SetGizmoPressed(down)
	self._gizmoDown = down
	if not down then
		self._gizmoUpTime = os.clock()
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Interno
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function ViewportInput:_gizmoBlocking()
	return self._gizmoDown or (os.clock() - self._gizmoUpTime) < 0.2
end

function ViewportInput:_contains(position)
	local origin = self.Viewport.AbsolutePosition
	local size = self.Viewport.AbsoluteSize
	return position.X >= origin.X
		and position.Y >= origin.Y
		and position.X <= origin.X + size.X
		and position.Y <= origin.Y + size.Y
end

function ViewportInput:_inJoystickZone(position)
	if not UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
		return false
	end
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then
		return false
	end
	local zone = Configuration.Camera.JoystickZone
	local size = camera.ViewportSize
	return position.X < size.X * zone.X and position.Y > size.Y * (1 - zone.Y)
end

function ViewportInput:_stopLooking()
	if self._looking then
		self._looking = false
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
	end
end

function ViewportInput:_cancelAll()
	self._press = nil
	self._touches = {}
	self:_stopLooking()
end

function ViewportInput:_onBegan(input, processed)
	local kind = input.UserInputType

	if kind == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
		if not processed and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
			self.KeyPressed:Fire(input.KeyCode)
		end
		return
	end

	if processed then
		return
	end

	if kind == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		local position = getGuiPosition(input)
		if self:_contains(position) then
			self._press = { Start = position, Moved = false }
		end
	elseif kind == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
		if self:_contains(getGuiPosition(input)) then
			self._looking = true
			UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCurrentPosition
		end
	elseif kind == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		local position = getGuiPosition(input)
		if self:_contains(position) then
			self._touches[input] = {
				Start = position,
				Last = position,
				Time = os.clock(),
				Moved = false,
				Look = not self:_inJoystickZone(position),
			}
		end
	end
end

function ViewportInput:_onChanged(input)
	local kind = input.UserInputType
	local maxMovement = Configuration.Editor.TapMaxMovement

	if kind == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
		if self._looking then
			self.LookDelta:Fire(input.Delta.X, input.Delta.Y, "Mouse")
		end
		local press = self._press
		if press and not press.Moved then
			if (getGuiPosition(input) - press.Start).Magnitude > maxMovement then
				press.Moved = true
			end
		end
	elseif kind == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		local state = self._touches[input]
		if not state then
			return
		end
		local position = getGuiPosition(input)
		local delta = position - state.Last
		state.Last = position
		if not state.Moved and (position - state.Start).Magnitude > maxMovement then
			state.Moved = true
		end
		if state.Moved and state.Look and not self:_gizmoBlocking() then
			self.LookDelta:Fire(delta.X, delta.Y, "Touch")
		end
	end
end

function ViewportInput:_onEnded(input)
	local kind = input.UserInputType

	if kind == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		local press = self._press
		self._press = nil
		if press and not press.Moved and not self:_gizmoBlocking() then
			self.Tapped:Fire(press.Start)
		end
	elseif kind == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
		self:_stopLooking()
	elseif kind == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		local state = self._touches[input]
		self._touches[input] = nil
		if
			state
			and not state.Moved
			and (os.clock() - state.Time) <= Configuration.Editor.TapMaxDuration
			and not self:_gizmoBlocking()
		then
			self.Tapped:Fire(state.Start)
		end
	end
end

function ViewportInput:Destroy()
	for _, connection in ipairs(self._connections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	self._connections = {}
	self:_cancelAll()
end

return ViewportInput
modules.TransformGizmo:
--[[
	TransformGizmo
	Tipo:  ModuleScript
	Ruta:  ReplicatedStorage > StudioLite > Modules > TransformGizmo
	Depende de: Configuration, Signal, SceneSync, SelectionManager

	Dibuja sobre el objeto seleccionado:
	  - un SelectionBox (contorno) para Parts y Models;
	  - con el modo "Move", flechas de movimiento (objeto Handles) alrededor de su
	    caja envolvente. Se usa una Part proxy invisible para que funcione igual
	    con una Part que con un Model entero.

	Las flechas NO modifican nada por sí solas: emiten eventos y el controlador
	aplica el movimiento al proyecto (el proyecto es la fuente de verdad).

	Los objetos del gizmo viven en PlayerGui (los Handles solo reciben ratón/toque
	desde ahí) y en Workspace.<EditorFolderName> (el proxy), todo solo en cliente.

	Eventos:
	  Pressed(down)       pulsar/soltar una flecha
	  DragStarted()
	  Dragged(offset)     Vector3 en mundo, ya ajustado a Configuration.Editor.MoveIncrement
	  DragEnded()

	Métodos: SetMode("None" | "Move"), Refresh(), IsDragging()
]]

local Configuration = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Configuration"))
local Signal = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Signal"))

local TransformGizmo = {}
TransformGizmo.__index = TransformGizmo

-- Caja envolvente alineada con los ejes del mundo de una Part o de todas las
-- Parts dentro de un Model. Devuelve CFrame (centro) y Vector3 (tamaño), o nil.
local function computeBounds(instance)
	local minimum, maximum

	local function include(part)
		local cframe, size = part.CFrame, part.Size
		local right, up, look = cframe.RightVector, cframe.UpVector, cframe.LookVector
		local extents = Vector3.new(
			(math.abs(right.X) * size.X + math.abs(up.X) * size.Y + math.abs(look.X) * size.Z) / 2,
			(math.abs(right.Y) * size.X + math.abs(up.Y) * size.Y + math.abs(look.Y) * size.Z) / 2,
			(math.abs(right.Z) * size.X + math.abs(up.Z) * size.Y + math.abs(look.Z) * size.Z) / 2
		)
		local low, high = cframe.Position - extents, cframe.Position + extents
		minimum = minimum and minimum:Min(low) or low
		maximum = maximum and maximum:Max(high) or high
	end

	if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
		include(instance)
	end
	for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			include(descendant)
		end
	end

	if not minimum then
		return nil
	end
	return CFrame.new((minimum + maximum) / 2), maximum - minimum
end

function TransformGizmo.new(project, scene, selection, playerGui)
	local self = setmetatable({}, TransformGizmo)

	self._project = project
	self._scene = scene
	self._selection = selection
	self._mode = "None"
	self._dragging = false
	self._startCFrame = CFrame.new()

	self.Pressed = Signal.new()
	self.DragStarted = Signal.new()
	self.Dragged = Signal.new()
	self.DragEnded = Signal.new()

	local editorFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild(Configuration.Scene.EditorFolderName)
	if not editorFolder then
		editorFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		editorFolder.Name = Configuration.Scene.EditorFolderName
		editorFolder.Parent = workspace
	end

	local proxy = Instance.new("Part")
	proxy.Name = "MoveProxy"
	proxy.Anchored = true
	proxy.CanCollide = false
	proxy.CanQuery = false
	proxy.CanTouch = false
	proxy.Transparency = 1
	proxy.Size = Vector3.one
	proxy.Parent = editorFolder
	self._proxy = proxy

	local selectionBox = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
	selectionBox.Name = "StudioLiteSelectionBox"
	selectionBox.Color3 = Configuration.Editor.SelectionColor
	selectionBox.SurfaceColor3 = Configuration.Editor.SelectionColor
	selectionBox.SurfaceTransparency = 0.9
	selectionBox.LineThickness = 0.03
	selectionBox.Parent = playerGui
	self._selectionBox = selectionBox

	local handles = Instance.new("Handles")
	handles.Name = "StudioLiteMoveHandles"
	handles.Style = Enum.HandlesStyle.Movement
	handles.Color3 = Configuration.Editor.SelectionColor
	handles.Parent = playerGui
	self._handles = handles

	handles.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
		self._dragging = true
		self._startCFrame = proxy.CFrame
		self.Pressed:Fire(true)
		self.DragStarted:Fire()
	end)

	handles.MouseDrag:Connect(function(face, distance)
		if not self._dragging then
			return
		end
		local increment = Configuration.Editor.MoveIncrement
		local snapped = increment > 0 and math.round(distance / increment) * increment or distance
		local offset = Vector3.fromNormalId(face) * snapped
		proxy.CFrame = self._startCFrame + offset
		self.Dragged:Fire(offset)
	end)

	handles.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
		if not self._dragging then
			return
		end
		self._dragging = false
		self.Pressed:Fire(false)
		self.DragEnded:Fire()
		self:Refresh()
	end)

	selection.Changed:Connect(function()
		self:Refresh()
	end)

	-- Si algo cambia las propiedades del objeto seleccionado (o de sus hijos)
	-- desde fuera del gizmo, las flechas se recolocan.
	project.NodeChanged:Connect(function(node, field)
		if self._dragging or field ~= "Property" then
			return
		end
		local selected = selection:Get()
		local current = node
		while current do
			if current == selected then
				task.defer(function()
					self:Refresh()
				end)
				return
			end
			current = current.Parent
		end
	end)

	return self
end

function TransformGizmo:SetMode(mode)
	self._mode = mode
	self:Refresh()
end

function TransformGizmo:IsDragging()
	return self._dragging
end

function TransformGizmo:Refresh()
	if self._dragging then
		return
	end

	local node = self._selection:Get()
	local instance = node and self._scene:GetInstance(node)
	local adornee = nil
	if instance and (instance:IsA("BasePart") or instance:IsA("Model")) then
		adornee = instance
	end
	self._selectionBox.Adornee = adornee

	local showHandles = false
	if adornee and self._mode == "Move" then
		local cframe, size = computeBounds(adornee)
		if cframe then
			self._proxy.CFrame = cframe
			self._proxy.Size = Vector3.new(math.max(size.X, 1), math.max(size.Y, 1), math.max(size.Z, 1))
			showHandles = true
		end
	end
	self._handles.Adornee = showHandles and self._proxy or nil
end

return TransformGizmo
modules.ExplorerController:
--[[
ExplorerController
Tipo:  ModuleScript
Ruta:  ReplicatedStorage > StudioLite > Modules > ExplorerController
Depende de: Configuration, SelectionManager (instancia), ProjectManager (instancia)

Muestra la jerarquía del proyecto (servicios y objetos) en ExplorerList usando
ExplorerItemTemplate. Los elementos de cada fila se buscan POR NOMBRE dentro de
la plantilla: Indent (UIPadding), Arrow (botón), Icon, Label. Si falta alguno
simplemente no se actualiza esa parte.

- Flecha: expande/contrae.   - Fila: selecciona el objeto.
- Se actualiza al crear, eliminar, renombrar o mover nodos.
- Al seleccionar desde el mundo 3D expande los padres y desplaza la lista.
- El resalte de la fila seleccionada solo cambia BackgroundTransparency, así
el color lo controla el fondo de tu plantilla.

explorer = ExplorerController.new(refs.Explorer, project, selection)
explorer:Start()
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Configuration = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Configuration"))

local ExplorerController = {}
ExplorerController.__index = ExplorerController

local DEFAULT_ROW_HEIGHT = 20

function ExplorerController.new(explorerRefs, project, selection)
    local self = setmetatable({}, ExplorerController)
    
    self._refs = explorerRefs
    self._project = project
    self._selection = selection
    
    self._expanded = {} -- Id -> true
    self._pool = {} -- filas reutilizables
    self._rowNode = {} -- fila -> nodo que muestra
    self._visible = {} -- lista plana de { Node, Depth }
    self._connections = {}
    self._dirty = false
    self._scrollPending = false
    
    for _, name in ipairs(Configuration.Explorer.ExpandedByDefault) do
        local service = project:GetService(name)
        if service then
            self._expanded[service.Id] = true
        end
    end
    
    return self
end

function ExplorerController:Start()
    local project = self._project
    
    self._refs.ItemTemplate.Visible = false
    
    table.insert(self._connections, project.NodeAdded:Connect(function()
        self:_request()
    end))
    table.insert(self._connections, project.NodeRemoving:Connect(function()
        self:_request()
    end))
    table.insert(self._connections, project.NodeChanged:Connect(function(_, field)
        if field == "Name" or field == "Parent" then
            self:_request()
        end
    end))
    table.insert(self._connections, self._selection.Changed:Connect(function(node)
        if node then
            self:_expandAncestors(node)
            self._scrollPending = true
        end
        self:_request()
    end))
    
    self:_refresh()
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Interno
---------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Agrupa varios cambios en una sola reconstrucción. Se difiere porque
-- NodeRemoving se dispara ANTES de que el nodo salga del árbol.
function ExplorerController:_request()
    if self._dirty then
        return
    end
    self._dirty = true
    task.defer(function()
        self:_refresh()
    end)
end

function ExplorerController:_expandAncestors(node)
    local current = node.Parent
    while current do
        self._expanded[current.Id] = true
        current = current.Parent
    end
end

function ExplorerController:ToggleExpanded(node)
    if not node then
        return
    end
    self._expanded[node.Id] = not self._expanded[node.Id] or nil
    self:_request()
end

function ExplorerController:_createRow()
    local row = self._refs.ItemTemplate:Clone()
    row.Name = "ExplorerItem"
    row.Visible = true
    row.Parent = self._refs.List
    
    table.insert(self._connections, row.Activated:Connect(function()
        local node = self._rowNode[row]
        if node then
            self._selection:Set(node)
        end
    end))
    
    local arrow = row:FindFirstChild("Arrow")
    if arrow and arrow:IsA("GuiButton") then
        table.insert(self._connections, arrow.Activated:Connect(function()
            self:ToggleExpanded(self._rowNode[row])
        end))
    end
    
    return row
end

function ExplorerController:_refresh()
    self._dirty = false
    
    local settings = Configuration.Explorer
    local selected = self._selection:Get()
    
    -- Lista plana de lo que se ve ahora mismo.
    local visible = {}
    local function walk(node, depth)
        table.insert(visible, { Node = node, Depth = depth })
        if self._expanded[node.Id] then
            for _, child in ipairs(node.Children) do
                walk(child, depth + 1)
            end
        end
    end
    for _, root in ipairs(self._project.Roots) do
        walk(root, 0)
    end
    self._visible = visible
    
    for index, entry in ipairs(visible) do
        local node = entry.Node
        local row = self._pool[index]
        if not row then
            row = self:_createRow()
            self._pool[index] = row
        end
        self._rowNode[row] = node
        
        row.LayoutOrder = index
        row.Visible = true
        row.BackgroundTransparency = (node == selected) and settings.SelectedTransparency or 1
        
        local indent = row:FindFirstChild("Indent")
        if indent and indent:IsA("UIPadding") then
            indent.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4 + entry.Depth * settings.IndentWidth)
        end
        
        local arrow = row:FindFirstChild("Arrow")
        if arrow then
            local hasChildren = #node.Children > 0
            arrow.Visible = hasChildren
            if arrow:IsA("TextButton") then
                arrow.Text = self._expanded[node.Id] and "v" or ">"
            end
        end
        
        local icon = row:FindFirstChild("Icon")
        if icon then
            local colors = settings.ClassColors
            icon.BackgroundColor3 = node.IsService and colors.Service or colors[node.ClassName] or colors.Default
        end
        
        local label = row:FindFirstChild("Label")
        if label then
            label.Text = node.Name
        end
    end
    
    -- Filas sobrantes (se conservan en la reserva para reutilizarlas).
    for index = #visible + 1, #self._pool do
        local row = self._pool[index]
        row.Visible = false
        self._rowNode[row] = nil
    end
    
    if self._scrollPending then
        self._scrollPending = false
        self:_scrollToSelected()
    end
end

function ExplorerController:_scrollToSelected()
    local selected = self._selection:Get()
    if not selected then
        return
    end
    
    local index
    for position, entry in ipairs(self._visible) do
        if entry.Node == selected then
            index = position
            break
        end
    end
    if not index then
        return
    end
    
    task.spawn(function()
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait() -- deja que el layout calcule el tamaño del canvas
        
        local list = self._refs.List
        local height = self._refs.ItemTemplate.Size.Y.Offset
        if height <= 0 then
            height = DEFAULT_ROW_HEIGHT
        end
        local top = (index - 1) * height
        local bottom = top + height
        local current = list.CanvasPosition.Y
        local window = list.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y
        
        if top < current then
            list.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, top)
        elseif bottom > current + window then
            list.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, bottom - window)
        end
    end)
end

function ExplorerController:Destroy()
    for _, connection in ipairs(self._connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    self._connections = {}
end

return ExplorerController

--[[
	Main
	Tipo:  LocalScript
	Ruta:  StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts > StudioLiteClient > Main
	       (StudioLiteClient es una Folder)
	(REEMPLAZA el de la etapa 2)
	Depende de: ReplicatedStorage.StudioLite.Modules.Configuration

	Punto de entrada del cliente.

	     del modelo de datos (resultados en Output).
	  2. Espera la interfaz en PlayerGui (la de StarterGui o la que cree el
	     LocalScript InterfaceGenerator si aún no la has extraído).
	  3. Conecta la interfaz mediante UIReferences e InterfaceController.
	  4. Crea el proyecto y arranca el editor 3D y el Explorer (EditorController).
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local studioLite = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("StudioLite")
local modules = studioLite:WaitForChild("Modules")

local Configuration = require(modules:WaitForChild("Configuration"))
local ProjectManager = require(modules:WaitForChild("ProjectManager"))
local UIReferences = require(modules:WaitForChild("UIReferences"))
local InterfaceController = require(modules:WaitForChild("InterfaceController"))
local EditorController = require(modules:WaitForChild("EditorController"))

local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local remotes = studioLite:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
if not remotes then
	warn("[StudioLite] No se encontró la carpeta Remotes. ¿Se ejecutó ProjectService?")
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Autotest del modelo de datos
---------------------------------------------------------------------

local function countNodes(project)
	local total = 0
	for _ in pairs(project.Nodes) do
		total += 1
	end
	return total
end

local function runSelfTest()
	local passed, failed = 0, 0

	local function check(label, condition)
		if condition then
			passed += 1
			print("  [OK] " .. label)
		else
			failed += 1
			warn("  [FALLO] " .. label)
		end
	end

	print("[StudioLite] Autotest del modelo de datos...")

	local project = ProjectManager.new("Prueba")
	local workspaceNode = project:GetService("Workspace")
	local replicated = project:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local serverScripts = project:GetService("ServerScriptService")

	local allServices = true
	for _, definition in ipairs(Configuration.Services) do
		if not project:GetService(definition.Name) then
			allServices = false
		end
	end
	check("Existen todos los servicios", allServices)
	check(
		"StarterPlayerScripts cuelga de StarterPlayer",
		project:GetService("StarterPlayerScripts").Parent == project:GetService("StarterPlayer")
	)

	local part = project:CreateNode("Part", workspaceNode, "Parte1")
	check("Crear Part en Workspace", part ~= nil and part.Parent == workspaceNode)

	local folder = project:CreateNode("Folder", replicated, "Carpeta")
	check(
		"Mover Part a otra carpeta",
		project:Reparent(part, folder) and project:GetPath(part) == "ReplicatedStorage.Carpeta.Parte1"
	)

	local ok = project:DestroyNode(workspaceNode)
	check("No se puede eliminar un servicio", ok == false)

	ok = project:Reparent(workspaceNode, folder)
	check("No se puede mover un servicio", ok == false)

	local subFolder = project:CreateNode("Folder", folder, "Sub")
	ok = project:Reparent(folder, subFolder)
	check("No se puede mover una carpeta dentro de sí misma", ok == false)

	local invalid = project:CreateNode("Humanoid", folder)
	check("Rechaza clases no soportadas", invalid == nil)

	local script = project:CreateNode("Script", serverScripts, "Logica")
	project:SetSource(script, 'print("hola")')
	project:SetProperty(part, "Anchored", true)
	project:SetProperty(project:GetService("Lighting"), "Brightness", 3)

	local copy = project:Export()
	local restored = ProjectManager.Import(copy)
	check("Exportar/Importar conserva todos los nodos", restored ~= nil and countNodes(restored) == countNodes(project))

	local restoredScript = restored and restored:GetNode(script.Id)
	check("Importar conserva el código del script", restoredScript ~= nil and restoredScript.Source == script.Source)

	local restoredPart = restored and restored:GetNode(part.Id)
	check("Importar conserva propiedades", restoredPart ~= nil and restoredPart.Properties.Anchored == true)
	check("Importar conserva la jerarquía", restoredPart ~= nil and restored:GetPath(restoredPart) == project:GetPath(part))
	check(
		"Importar conserva propiedades de servicios",
		restored ~= nil and restored:GetService("Lighting").Properties.Brightness == 3
	)

	project:DestroyNode(folder)
	check("Eliminar una carpeta elimina sus descendientes", project:GetNode(part.Id) == nil and project:GetNode(subFolder.Id) == nil)

	local summary = string.format("[StudioLite] Autotest: %d correctas, %d fallidas", passed, failed)
	if failed > 0 then
		warn(summary)
	else
		print(summary)
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Interfaz
---------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Devuelve el ScreenGui del editor: el que ya está en PlayerGui (copiado desde
-- StarterGui) o el que genere el LocalScript InterfaceGenerator. Espera hasta 10 s
-- porque el generador solo actúa si no encuentra la interfaz tras unos segundos.
local function getInterface()
	local gui = playerGui:WaitForChild(Configuration.InterfaceName, 10)
	if not gui then
		warn("[StudioLite] No hay '" .. Configuration.InterfaceName .. "' en PlayerGui. Pon la interfaz en StarterGui o añade el LocalScript InterfaceGenerator")
	end
	return gui
end

local function startInterface()
	local gui = getInterface()
	if not gui then
		return nil
	end

	local refs, missing, optionalMissing = UIReferences.Resolve(gui)
	if #missing > 0 then
		warn("[StudioLite] Faltan elementos de interfaz: " .. table.concat(missing, ", "))
		return nil
	end
	if #optionalMissing > 0 then
		warn("[StudioLite] Faltan elementos opcionales (regenera la interfaz para tener los controles móviles): " .. table.concat(optionalMissing, ", "))
	end

	local controller = InterfaceController.new(refs)
	controller:Start()

	if Configuration.Debug then
		controller.ToolRequested:Connect(function(toolId)
			print("[StudioLite] Herramienta: " .. toolId)
		end)
		controller.CommandRequested:Connect(function(commandId)
			print("[StudioLite] Comando: " .. commandId)
		end)
	end

	print("[StudioLite] Interfaz conectada")
	return controller, refs
end

--[[
ProjectService
Tipo:  Script (servidor)
Ruta:  ServerScriptService > StudioLiteServer > ProjectService
(StudioLiteServer es una Folder)
Depende de: ReplicatedStorage.StudioLite.Modules.Configuration

Etapa 1: prepara en el servidor la carpeta Remotes y las RemoteFunctions
declaradas en Configuration.Remotes.
Los manejadores reales (listar, crear, guardar y cargar proyectos con
DataStore) se implementan en la etapa 8. Hasta entonces cada remote
responde con un error claro en lugar de quedarse sin respuesta.
]]

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local studioLite = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("StudioLite")
local modules = studioLite:WaitForChild("Modules")
local Configuration = require(modules:WaitForChild("Configuration"))

local remotesFolder = studioLite:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
if not remotesFolder then
    remotesFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
    remotesFolder.Name = "Remotes"
    remotesFolder.Parent = studioLite
end

for _, remoteName in ipairs(Configuration.Remotes) do
    local remote = remotesFolder:FindFirstChild(remoteName)
    if not remote then
        remote = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
        remote.Name = remoteName
        remote.Parent = remotesFolder
    end
    
    if remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
        remote.OnServerInvoke = function()
            return { Ok = false, Error = "NotImplemented" }
        end
    else
        warn("[StudioLite] '" .. remoteName .. "' existe pero no es una RemoteFunction")
    end
end
